readings.Aries: You can start over. You've done it before. The question is whether that's what this requires. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Taurus: You've been working hard for a very long time. That is not the problem. The absence of rest is. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Gemini: There is someone in your life who needs your full attention, not your cleverness. Give it to them. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Cancer: You absorb the emotional state of every room you enter. This is information. It's also exhausting. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Leo: You contain more generosity than you sometimes access. Today, go deeper. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Virgo: Your willingness to work harder than necessary has served you. It has also cost you things. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Libra: You are diplomatic to a fault. The fault is visible to others even when you don't intend it. Let this one be easy.
readings.Scorpio: You have been in the dark long enough to know it. The light is coming and you will be ready. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Sagittarius: Something you've been calling freedom is starting to look like avoidance from a certain angle. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Capricorn: Your relationship with time is complex. You are either far ahead of it or burdened by its passage. Today: present tense. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Aquarius: The independence you protect is real and necessary. Today it is being used defensively rather than freely. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Pisces: There is something you've been trying to hold together that wants to fall apart constructively. Let it. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
